meta.name: drive-desktop-app
meta.description: Drive and verify an Electron or Tauri desktop app from the inside, including the main-process and Rust IPC calls a browser tool cannot see. Use when a desktop app needs testing, when a feature works in the browser but not in the packaged app, when an IPC or invoke call needs proving, when a desktop screenshot or visual diff is wanted, or when you need a headless run of a desktop UI in CI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把打包后的桌面应用跑起来,自动验证点击和底层调用是否真的生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果桌面应用在浏览器里正常、打包后却出问题。
copy.tagline_en: Test your packaged desktop app from the inside, even its main-process calls.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your desktop app works in the browser but breaks once packaged.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能驱动并验证 Electron 或 Tauri 桌面应用,包括浏览器工具看不到的主进程和 Rust IPC 调用,并判断一次 IPC 命令是否真的成功。
howto.when: 当需要测试桌面应用、功能在浏览器里正常但打包后失效、或要验证一次 IPC/invoke 调用时触发。

say.text: 点一下归档待办,确认 ipc://todos:archive 返回成功。
say.note: 用 IPC 断言而不是网络断言来判定。

say.text: 把打包版和开发版的界面截图对比一下,看有没有视觉差异。
say.note: Electron 直接可用,Tauri 需装 crate。

say.text: 在 CI 里无头跑一遍这个 Tauri 应用的界面。

howto.what_en: Claude can drive and verify Electron or Tauri desktop apps from the inside, including main-process and Rust IPC calls a browser tool cannot see, and report whether an IPC command actually succeeded.
howto.when_en: Use when testing a desktop app, when a feature works in the browser but not in the packaged app, or when you need to prove an IPC/invoke call.

say_en.text: Click archive on a todo and confirm ipc://todos:archive returned success.
say_en.note: Judges via IPC predicates, not network.

say_en.text: Compare screenshots of the packaged and dev builds for visual differences.
say_en.note: Works on Electron; Tauri needs the crate.

say_en.text: Run this Tauri app's UI headless in CI.
